**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier covenant binding Mortgage Logic.com. Key points:

- **§ 2(a) (p0022/p0024)** grants a *non-exclusive* licence and expressly preserves our sourcing freedom: Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system... to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink." The only limits are non-infringement of TrueLink IP and our § 10 confidentiality obligations — standard carve-outs, not restraints on procurement.
- **§ 8(d) (p0054)** is the reverse direction: Client grants TrueLink a *nonexclusive* licence to Credit Data, and the referenced Non-Competition Agreement operates as a *limitation on TrueLink*, which benefits us and is therefore not flagged.
- The only other "exclusive" usage is the exclusive-forum language in § 12 (p0094), which is unrelated to exclusive dealing.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no exclusivity on Customer, plus affirmative freedom-to-source language), so no edit is needed. Worth noting for the file: the referenced "Non-Competition Agreement" is not defined or attached in this document — we should confirm it contains no reciprocal restraint on Client's ability to use other credit-data providers, though nothing in this agreement creates one.
